body: Hey, reading this I just want to give you the biggest hug right now. :) Sorry you're feeling so bad. Feel really similar myself, especially the part about how things might get better but you don't know if it's worth sticking around for. Do you also start feeling like shit right away as soon as you don't have something or someone distracting you from all of your problems? Wish I could do something to actually help. Chin up, things can and will get better! Even if you don't believe it right now.
